original_ai_output.title_zh: 拉各斯一建筑倒塌致1死3伤
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚拉各斯州Fadeyi地区Akinola街一栋建筑于周五上午倒塌，造成1人死亡、3人受伤。拉各斯州应急管理局表示，事故原因尚未确定，救援人员仍在确认有多少现场工人被困在废墟下。目前该事件为单一来源报道。

location.raw_text: Akinola Street, off Ikorodu Road, Fadeyi area of Lagos State

key_facts.fact: 拉各斯州Fadeyi地区一栋建筑倒塌，造成1人死亡、3人受伤
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: One person has died while three others sustained injuries following the collapse of a building in the Fadeyi area of Lagos State.

key_facts.fact: 倒塌建筑位于Akinola街，靠近Ikorodu路，事发于周五上午
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The building collapsed on Akinola Street, off Ikorodu Road, on Friday morning.

key_facts.fact: 拉各斯州应急管理局称事故原因尚未确定
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Lagos State Emergency Management Agency said the cause of the incident was yet to be established

key_facts.fact: 救援人员正在确认有多少现场工人仍被困在废墟下
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: rescue teams were working to determine how many site workers remained trapped beneath the rubble

uncertainties: 被困工人人数尚未确认
目前仅有一个来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
